dataQuality.missingPrice: {count} asset(s) have no market price — excluded from NAV
dataQuality.transactionImplied: {count} asset(s) valued at their last transaction price — no market price available for over 2 weeks (as of {as_of_date})
dataQuality.currentPriceAssumedAtCost: Current price unavailable — open value estimated at cost, market P&L excluded
dataQuality.currentPriceAssumedAtCostRange: No market price available between {date_from} and {date_to} — open value estimated at cost, market P&L excluded

dataQuality.navIncomplete: NAV incomplete for {count} day(s) between {date_from} and {date_to}
dataQuality.mwrrNotAvailable: MWRR cannot be calculated for this period
dataQuality.archivedAsset: This asset is archived — not updated by scheduler
dataQuality.fxPairMissing: FX pair not configured — conversion not available
dataQuality.fxPairPartialGap: Partial gap in rates — data from {date}
dataQuality.referencePriceFallback: Lot opening price unavailable on the exact date — using last known price {reference_price} as reference for relative return
dataQuality.referencePriceUnavailable: No reference price available for a lot opening — relative return cannot be computed
dataQuality.shortTransferNotSupported: Transfer of a short position is not supported yet (broker {broker_id})

dataQuality.missingCostBasis: {count} asset(s) have an acquisition without a purchase cost — counted at zero until you set it
dataQuality.valuedAtCost: {count} asset(s) valued at cost — no price available for over 2 weeks (as of {as_of_date})
dataQuality.transferShareMismatch: {count} transfer(s) between brokers where your share differs — the difference counts as a gain or loss
dataQuality.invalidSplitRatio: {count} asset(s) have a split with an invalid ratio — ignored until you fix it in the asset's events
dataQuality.transactionsBeforeFloor: {count} transaction(s) dated before 1900 (the earliest on {earliest}) — the history starts on 1 January 1900: correct their dates
